profile.subtitleJa: ティルスの王として、ソロモンから書簡を受け取る人物です。
profile.summaryJa: 歴代誌下2:3では、ソロモンがティルスの王フラムに書簡を送ります。

facts.textJa: ティルスの王フラムが書簡で返答します。
フラムはソロモンについて語ります。
フラムは船と航海に詳しい者たちをソロモンへ送ります。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryWitnesses.text: Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, “As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell, so deal with me.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 候補の綴りは固定WEB本文にそのまま現れず、同一人物と断定できない。
primaryWitnesses.text: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because the LORD loves his people, he has made you king over them.”

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 候補の綴りは固定WEB本文にそのまま現れず、同一人物と断定できない。
primaryWitnesses.text: Huram continued, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 候補の綴りは固定WEB本文にそのまま現れず、同一人物と断定できない。
primaryWitnesses.text: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 候補の綴りは固定WEB本文にそのまま現れず、同一人物と断定できない。
primaryWitnesses.text: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 候補の綴りは固定WEB本文にそのまま現れず、同一人物と断定できない。
primaryWitnesses.text: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 候補の綴りは固定WEB本文にそのまま現れず、同一人物と断定できない。
primaryWitnesses.text: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
